description: Creates or changes the workspace's website tracker (the 'Visitou seu site' signal) and returns the install snippet: two script lines the customer puts before </head> on every page of their site, the domains it accepts visits from (the workspace's site by default), and a default paragraph for their privacy policy. The script identifies the COMPANY behind a visit by its network (not the person); a person only when they identify themselves: tagCampaignLinks adds a signed nk parameter to the campaign links that point to the customer's own site, and a form can call nock.identify(email). consentMode 'notice' respects Do Not Track; 'opt_in' sends nothing before nock.consent(true). citeVisits lets messages mention the visit (off by default: the visit only times the message). Visits are kept 90 days. Free. Once installed, the visiting companies can feed a signal monitor of category 'visitor' (periodDays 7/14/30, minStrength 0-100, buyingPagesOnly; 2 credits per company, +2 per decision maker found).

domains.description: The site's domains, e.g. ["acme.com.br"]; subdomains are included.
